# ReferralCandy

> ReferralCandy is a referral and affiliate marketing platform for ecommerce brands, offering tools for customer acquisition, retention, and word-of-mouth growth strategies.

The site provides referral program software for Shopify and ecommerce stores, along with educational content on influencer marketing, affiliate strategies, and customer retention. Featured contributors include Raúl Galera, Elmeri Palokangas, Alfred Lua, and Marquis Matson.

## Key Topics

- ReferralCandy
- Shopify
- Referral programs
- Affiliate marketing
- Ecommerce growth
- Customer acquisition
- Influencer marketing
- Customer retention
- Word-of-mouth marketing
- Ecommerce marketing
- Social media marketing (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
- Content marketing
- Marketing analytics
- Competitor research
- 2026 marketing guides
